employees.ddl: employee_id STRING, full_name STRING, first_name STRING, last_name STRING, email STRING, grade STRING, grade_level INT, practice STRING, office STRING, manager_id STRING, hire_date DATE, employment_type STRING, annual_utilisation_target DOUBLE, is_active BOOLEAN
employees.comment: HR master data. One row per employee. manager_id is the line manager (self-join to employee_id). Utilisation target is billable hours / available hours.

clients.ddl: client_id STRING, client_name STRING, industry STRING, city STRING, country STRING, billing_currency STRING, client_tier STRING, relationship_partner_id STRING, client_since DATE
clients.comment: CRM client master. relationship_partner_id joins to employees.employee_id.

engagements.ddl: engagement_code STRING, engagement_name STRING, engagement_type STRING, client_id STRING, practice STRING, billing_type STRING, engagement_partner_id STRING, engagement_manager_id STRING, start_date DATE, end_date DATE, status STRING, sow_reference STRING
engagements.comment: Engagement (project) master: client engagements plus internal non-chargeable time codes (INT-*). Fees and agreed day rates are only in the Statement of Work PDFs.

engagement_assignments.ddl: assignment_id STRING, engagement_code STRING, employee_id STRING, role STRING, allocation_pct DOUBLE, assigned_from DATE, assigned_to DATE
engagement_assignments.comment: Resourcing: which employees are staffed on which engagement, their role and planned allocation (0-1).
